description: Land Title Settlement Department - Welipathayaya, Balangoda D/S Division, Rathnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620003
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including their extent, ownership details, and any encumbrances. The content focuses on land registration, property ownership determinations, and land title settlements, which squarely fits the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
